title: SARCLIP: A Scalable CLIP-Based Retrieval System for Seventeenth-Century Spanish American Notary Records
abstract: arXiv:2608.22036v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Historical manuscript archives resist standard text search due to inconsistent handwriting, archaic orthography, and the absence of reliable transcriptions at scale. We present SARCLIP (Spanish American Notary Records Meets CLIP), a deployed retrieval system for the National Archives of Argentina's seventeenth-century Spanish American notary records, a corpus of more than 13.6 million word-image patches spanning over 100 microfilm rolls ("rollos"). SARCLIP is built on a CLIP ViT-B/16 model contrastively fine-tuned on paleography-expert-annotated data, and extends prior work by (1) scaling approximate nearest-neighbor retrieval to the near-complete corpus via a FAISS index, (2) refining top-k results through pseudo-relevance feedback (Rocchio), and (3) closing a human-in-the-loop cycle through visual document browsing, canvas-based patch annotation, and periodic model retraining. translated_title: SARCLIP：面向十七世纪西属美洲公证文书的可扩展CLIP检索系统
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.22036v1 公告类型：新  摘要：历史手稿档案因字迹不一致、古体拼写以及缺乏大规模可靠转录而难以进行标准文本搜索。我们提出了SARCLIP（西属美洲公证文书与CLIP的结合），这是一个部署于阿根廷国家档案馆十七世纪西属美洲公证文书的检索系统，该语料包含超过1360万个词图像块，覆盖100多卷缩微胶卷（“rollos”）。SARCLIP基于CLIP ViT-B/16模型，通过古文字学专家标注数据进行对比微调，并扩展了先前工作，具体包括：（1）通过FAISS索引将近邻检索扩展到近乎完整的语料库，（2）通过伪相关反馈（Rocchio）优化top-k结果，（3）通过视觉文档浏览、基于画布的图像块标注和定期模型重训练，实现人机协同闭环。与系统的初始研究原型不同，该原型仅评估了...
tldr: SARCLIP通过CLIP模型对比微调、FAISS索引扩展检索、伪相关反馈优化和人机协同闭环，首次实现了对阿根廷国家档案馆十七世纪西属美洲公证文书超1360万图像块的大规模高效检索。
en_tdlr: SARCLIP achieves large-scale efficient retrieval of over 13.6 million image patches from seventeenth-century Spanish American notary records via contrastive fine-tuning of CLIP, FAISS-indexed nearest-neighbor search, pseudo-relevance feedback, and a human-in-the-loop annotation cycle.
